No new Mesh(), mesh.vertices, SetVertices, RecalculateNormals, or SetData usage exists in the Surface Nets module.

SurfaceNetExtractionJob emits one centroid vertex per sign-crossing cell and unmanaged indices.

GlobalQualityWeight controls 25%-100% sampling, stride 4..1, centroid bias, cadence 5..60 Hz, and telemetry decimation ratio.

Surface Nets stages physics bake requests but does not own MeshCollider or direct Physics.BakeMesh calls.
VoxelSurfaceAabbShiftJob updates BRG AABB centers while vertices remain chunk-local float3.
Persistent workspace is entirely DataVault-owned; runtime mesher owns zero private NativeArray/NativeList fields.
300-frame telemetry ring and endian-marked dumps are implemented.
Voxel Mesh Tuner EditorWindow reads/writes unmanaged tuning.
meshing_profiles.csv parser uses vault byte scratch and ASCII key hashes.
Show Raw Extraction draws yellow raw triangle wireframes from raw float3 workspace in SceneView.

SELF_AUDIT.SCALABILITY_CURVE: When GlobalQualityWeight drops below 0.3, SurfaceNetExtractionJob collapses toward stride 4 and nearest SDF normal sampling, biases vertices toward cell centers, and uploads fewer vertices through the same GraphicsBuffer path. At 1.0, the job uses full 32^3 traversal, trilinear density sampling for normals, richer packed material scalars, and optional raw debug capture.
